text_blocks.snippet: PASSHE stands for the Pennsylvania State System of Higher Education. It is a state-owned university system in Pennsylvania that oversees 10 state-owned universities. PASSHE's mission is to provide high-quality, affordable education and training opportunities beyond high school, preparing students for professional and personal success.
